issues: 整张 SVG 在 480 宽设计坐标里栅格化再放大 4 倍，砂化时的噪点是糊成一团的雾，看不到颗粒
辉光是一层 drop-shadow，凝聚冲高时字标外面罩着一块均匀的灰白方雾
背景是死平的 #0a0a0c，没有任何深度；字体回落到 Helvetica
"凝聚"只靠滤镜位移归零，画面里没有任何东西真的在向中心收拢
选区框只是淡入淡出，出场方式和砂化能量无关
changes: SVG 改为按 1920×1080 原生分辨率栅格化（viewBox 不变、1 单位 = 3px），噪点细到 2–3px 的砂粒，时间轴与滤镜参数全部保持原值
辉光移进滤镜链：紧光 + 宽光两层冷白 bloom，强度仍走原三段包络，凝固后只剩贴字边的柔光余温
加 150 粒确定性游离砂粒：砂化时被吹散并随 seed 节拍闪烁，0.56 起以 inQuart 错峰加速吸回字标、0.66–0.80 熄灭；字标凝聚时 1.06→1 收缩“被压实”
凝聚冲高处给一次横向光痕（细芯 + 宽晕，0.74–0.92 消退），只给主角一次
背景换成带冷色相的 Backdrop（中心柔光 + 暗角 + 颗粒）；选区框随砂化从中线横向展开、撤场时收拢；字体换系统字体栈
issuesEn: The whole SVG was rasterised at 480px design width and scaled 4x, so the dissolve noise was a soft fog with no visible grain
The glow was a single drop-shadow, putting a uniform grey-white haze box around the wordmark at the peak
The background was flat #0a0a0c with no depth, and the font fell back to Helvetica
"Condensing" relied only on the displacement returning to zero; nothing on screen actually gathered toward the centre
The selection box only faded in and out, unrelated to the energy of the dissolve
changesEn: The SVG now rasterises at native 1920×1080 (same viewBox, 1 unit = 3px), so the noise reads as 2–3px sand; all timings and filter values unchanged
Glow moved into the filter chain as a tight plus wide two-layer cool-white bloom on the original three-stage envelope, leaving only a soft rim after lock

Added 150 deterministic loose sand grains: blown outward and flickering with the seed beat during the dissolve, pulled back into the wordmark from 0.56 with staggered inQuart acceleration, fading out over 0.66–0.80; the wordmark compresses 1.06→1 as it condenses
A single horizontal light streak (thin core plus wide halo) at the condensation peak, fading over 0.74–0.92, given to the hero only once
Background is now a cool-tinted Backdrop (centre glow, vignette, grain); the selection box unfolds horizontally from the centre with the dissolve and folds in on exit; system font stack
